cross_references.relationship: §1826 investigator must assess whether §1801 grounds are met. The investigator's report is the factual foundation for the court's §1801 finding. No §1801 appointment is valid without §1826 investigation compliance.

structural parallel — §1826 is the pre-appointment investigation; §1851 is the ongoing periodic review. Same investigator function, same duties, but §1851 applies after appointment with biennial frequency.

§1826(a)(4)(B) cross-references §811 directly — the investigator must determine whether §811 mental function deficits exist and significantly impair the proposed conservatee's ability to function. §811 is the clinical framework the §1826 investigation must apply.
